entities.summary: James Iley McCord was an American religious figure who was president of Princeton Theological Seminary. He also won the 1986 Templeton Prize. Born in Rusk, Texas on November 24, 1919, McCord died from complications of Parkinson's disease at Princeton Medical Center, on February 19, 1990, at the age of 70.
